name: Weather
description: Condition icon in the bar and a forecast panel (Omarchy's weather: wttr.in + Open-Meteo, every 15 min while enabled; off by default). Location: settings, else GeoClue, else IP

location.description: City or lat,lon; empty = GeoClue (haseen setup geoclue), else wttr.in guesses from your IP

locationName.description: Label shown for a lat,lon location (set by the panel's city search)

units.description: metric (°C, km/h), imperial (°F, mph), or empty = from the forecast's country, else the locale

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC targets haseen.weather (loadFixture, refresh, state) and haseen.weather.panel, and stop automatic fetching
